name: dsh-tool-clmengine
description:
Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Engine for DeepSeek Harness.
AI-powered contract drafting with template library, negotiation assistance with
historical analysis and strategy recommendations, obligation tracking with Gantt
visualization and compliance scoring, renewal management with condition change
detection and market benchmarking, contract analysis with full-text search and
risk mapping, AI clause negotiation with data processing and IP assignment
workflows, signature orchestration with multi-party routing and global compliance
(eIDAS/ESIGN), and comprehensive compliance verification with FCPA/UKBA and
sanctions screening. Navy blue contract theme throughout.
